feedback_driven.quote: These results suggest that harness lessons can outlive the failures they were written to fix, while drift persists and still needs mechanical checks.

persists_across_tasks.quote: I replayed five past failures in isolated git clones, with and without their fixes.

data.study_quote: I report a six-week case study of my personal system of record, a plain-markdown repository that three AI agent tools edited daily under one shared rule set.
data.why_zh: 六周案例研究：失败驱动的规则/校验持续演化与留存
